summary: Iteration 13 – Mobile Expo web preview validation of three new features. All three features verified end-to-end on the Expo web preview at 390x844: (1) OB & CART_PATH drawing tools render in the course editor drawing-tools scroller with correct testIDs (editor-draw-ob, editor-draw-cart_path). Selecting either reveals the draft control row (editor-draw-undo + editor-draw-finish). Pressing FINISH with <min points triggers the 'Tap at least 3 points first' toast (screenshot captured) without crashing, and editor-save-btn tap succeeds ('Course saved' toast) so the mode-selection / draft state does not break persistence. GolfMap.web is a stub — actual on-map vertex placing is native-only per spec; this is expected. (2) /trends: LAST 5 / LAST 10 / ALL chips (trend-range-5/10/all) all render; ALL is highlighted as the default (matches user choice). 1 seeded round renders as a single black/blue/green bar per card (Score to Par, Putts, GIR %). trend-bar-0 exists once per chart (3 duplicate data-testid attributes across the 3 Bars sections — see minor issue). Tapping trend-bar-0.first navigates to /rounds/70e34bff-83ad-4c55-bbc8-25691b8a001f and renders the round detail table (screenshot captured). Chip clicks toggle range without crashing. (3) /play: rangefinder-screen mounts; auto-advance-banner correctly absent (GPS is denied in the preview so the >45m-off-green trigger cannot fire — expected). Screen does not crash despite the new auto-advance useEffect + advNearGreenRef refs + advancePrompt state; adjacent GPS-driven UI (GPS DENIED helper card, dist-arcs-btn, right controls) still renders. Code review confirms the banner block (lines 654-665 of play.tsx) correctly renders {advancePrompt && ...} with testIDs auto-advance-banner / auto-advance-yes-btn / auto-advance-no-btn, and GO calls goHole(nextIdx) which persists currentHole via PUT /rounds/{id}. Testing type was 'frontend only' — backend not re-run (iteration_12 already covered /stats returning recentRounds).
action_items: MINOR: /app/mobile/app/trends.tsx line 42 – testID `trend-bar-${i}` collides across the three <Bars/> cards (bar-0/1/... appear three times each in the DOM, once per chart). Not functionally broken (each Pressable still works) but breaks unique-selector expectations for automated tests. Consider prefixing by chart, e.g. testID=`trend-${title}-bar-${i}`, or scope with the surrounding card testID.

MINOR (carried from iteration_12, still valid): /app/mobile/app/courses/[id]/edit.tsx – setMode() does not clear the current draft, so switching from DRAW FAIRWAY → DRAW GREEN mid-drawing re-types the accumulated vertices as GREEN. Editor already sets `setDraft(null)` on the draw-* buttons via `onPress={() => { setDraft(null); setMode(...) }}` (line 164), so this is only a risk when switching between hazard/POI/marker modes and back into a draw:* mode — check flow with a longer trace.

MINOR (carried from iteration_12): /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/play.tsx line ~530 next-tee-banner increments holeIdx without an upper bound check; the new auto-advance path at lines 322-336 does check `nextIdx < course.holes.length` correctly, so the new auto-advance code is safer than the older next-tee banner.

MINOR: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/play.tsx line ~322-336 – both nearGreenRef (putt reminder, 18m/35m thresholds) and advNearGreenRef (auto-advance, 18m/45m thresholds) run against the SAME greenCenter distance; consider a single ref to avoid the two effects racing when the golfer crosses the boundaries in quick succession, and also add a `nextHole.tee` distance check so 'Next hole {n}' isn't offered when the player is actually walking toward the clubhouse.
critical_code_review_comments: edit.tsx line 163: OB and CART_PATH added to the draw-type array — correct. Note the testID uses .toLowerCase() on the display key so CART_PATH → editor-draw-cart_path (underscore preserved). Matches spec.
edit.tsx line 96-102 finishShape: minPts=2 for CART_PATH, 3 otherwise — matches spec. Uses draft.type check, safe.
GolfMap.tsx line 203-208: polygons filter excludes CART_PATH from fill polygons — correct. Line 209-213: CART_PATH rendered as dashed LineString with line-dasharray [2,2] and #e5e7eb — matches spec.
GolfMap.tsx line 59: OB polygon color is #ef4444 red — correct.
trends.tsx line 61: default range = 'all' — matches user choice.
trends.tsx line 71: slice(-(range as number)) returns the LAST N (most recent) rounds — correct given `[...recentRounds].reverse()` puts oldest→newest.
trends.tsx line 76-77: openRound only navigates if r.id truthy — safe.
play.tsx line 322-336: auto-advance uses advNearGreenRef gate + advanceOfferedRef Set (dedupe by hole) + course.holes.length bound + course.holes[nextIdx]?.tee check — well-guarded.
play.tsx line 658: GO handler calls goHole(nextIdx) which persists currentHole to server — correct integration.
